run_cluster_hdbscan: run HDBSCAN clustering on a dataset and retrieve cluster labels and point probabilities
test_dbscan_scale_sensitivity: test DBSCAN clustering on scaled datasets to demonstrate eps parameter sensitivity
run_hdbscan_multiscale: run HDBSCAN clustering to detect multi-scale clusters with varying densities
test_hdbscan_min_cluster_size: test HDBSCAN with different min_cluster_size values to evaluate cluster granularity
summarize_hdbscan_dbscan_clustering: summarize HDBSCAN dbscan_clustering method to extract clusterings at different cut distances
